description: This file defines the IndexSelectOperator class, a custom operator for tensor index selection in PyTorch, including methods for generating input specs, code generation, and operator metadata.

classes.name: IndexSelectOperator
classes.description: Operator for selecting elements from a tensor along a dimension using indices.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the IndexSelectOperator and sets its name.

methods.name: str|None torch_op_name(self)
methods.description: Property that returns the associated PyTorch operation name, 'torch.index_select'.

methods.name: bool can_produce(self, output_spec: Spec)
methods.description: Determines if the operator can produce a tensor with the given specification.

methods.name: list[Spec] fuzz_inputs_specs(self, output_spec: Spec, num_inputs: int = 3)
methods.description: Generates input specifications for the index_select operation based on output specification.

methods.name: str codegen( self, output_name: str, input_names: list[str], output_spec: Spec )
methods.description: Generates PyTorch code to perform the index_select operation based on input and output specs.
